description: You are a public health epidemiologist analyzing HIV surveillance data to characterize transmission routes and demographic risk factors. The HIV dataset (C:\EpiInfo7\Projects\HIV\HIV.mdb, table: Case) is bundled with Epi Info 7 and contains individual-level case data. Your tasks are: (1) Read the HIV Case dataset into Classic Analysis. (2) Use FREQ to explore all variables and understand the dataset structure — identify variables related to transmission category, age group, sex, race/ethnicity, and CD4 count or AIDS indicator. (3) Run MEANS or FREQ analyses on continuous variables (e.g., age or CD4 if available). (4) Run TABLES analyses for each transmission category versus AIDS status or other outcome indicators. (5) Select specific subgroups using SELECT statements (e.g., SELECT SEX="Male" or similar) and run stratified analyses. (6) Output all results to C:\Users\Docker\hiv_transmission_analysis.html using ROUTEOUT. (7) Write a cross-tabulation summary to C:\Users\Docker\hiv_transmission_summary.csv using WRITE. The goal is a comprehensive descriptive and stratified epidemiological analysis of HIV transmission patterns.
